findings.source_quote: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing –Luke 22:35.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the duplicated word in the Afrikaans translation so the three items are distinct (purse, scrip, shoes). For example: replace “sonder beursie en beursie en skoene” with “sonder beursie, sak (of beurs) en skoene” or “sonder beursie, beurs/ruim sak en skoene” depending on the preferred term. Preserve the surrounding <em> and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Later, toe hulle teruggekom het, het Jesus hulle gevra: En hy het vir hulle gesê: Toe ek julle sonder beursie en beursie en skoene gestuur het, het julle iets gemis? En hulle het gesê: Niks –Lukas 22:35.

findings.location: Paragraph: “In reckless abandonment he stepped off her deck …and a miracle happened.”
findings.source_quote: In reckless abandonment he stepped off her deck …and a miracle happened.
findings.suggested_fix: The phrase “roekelose losbandigheid” has a sexual/ licentious connotation in Afrikaans. Use a phrasing that preserves the intended sense of bold, wholehearted abandon, e.g. “in roekelose vertroue” or “in roekelose oorgawe” to better match the English meaning. Preserve surrounding tags and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: In roekelose losbandigheid het hy van die dek af gestap …en ’n wonder gebeur.

findings.location: Paragraph: “they that were in the ship came and worshipped him...”
findings.source_quote: then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God –Matthew 14:33.
findings.suggested_fix: The translation uses “opgedaag en Hom aanbid”, where “opgedaag” reads awkwardly for ‘came to Him’ in this context. Use a clearer phrasing such as “toe het dié wat in die skip was na Hom gekom en Hom aangebid” to better reflect the original temporal/action sequence. Preserve the <em> tags and verse citation.
findings.translation_quote: toe het hulle wat in die skip was opgedaag en Hom aanbid en gesê: Regtig, U is die Seun van God –Matteus 14:33.

findings.location: Paragraph: “Many of the simple commands of Christ have no apparent scientific reasoning.”
findings.source_quote: Many of the simple commands of Christ have no apparent scientific reasoning.
findings.suggested_fix: There is a small typo/word-choice in Afrikaans: “eensynige” should be corrected to “eensinnige” (or rephrase to “duidelike wetenskaplike verklaring”) to convey ‘apparent/clear scientific reasoning’ accurately. E.g. replace “geen eensynige wetenskaplike redenasie nie” with “geen duidelike wetenskaplike redenasie nie.” Preserve punctuation and surrounding sentence structure.
findings.translation_quote: Baie van die eenvoudige gebooie van Christus het geen eensynige wetenskaplike redenasie nie.
